title: Matched NVE-production sensitivity for LLZTO occupancy realization 0 at 800 K
research_question: Does replacing the 100 fs Nose-Hoover production thermostat with energy-conserving dynamics materially alter tracer, collective, or collective-to-tracer transport after the same NVT equilibration?
primary_estimands: NVE versus NVT tracer diffusivity ratio
NVE versus NVT collective diffusivity ratio
NVE versus NVT collective-to-tracer ratio contrast
stopping_rule: The matched 800 K NVE point must pass the same tracer and collective diffusion rules as the NVT reference, remain within ten percent of 800 K, and satisfy the frozen absolute energy-drift limit. An unresolved point is extended under a separately fingerprinted protocol rather than dropped.
preregistration_note: Frozen while the first formal 700 K trajectory was incomplete and before any formal 800 K transport result existed.

gates.criterion: Run only after the full universal-potential domain gate passes.

Reuse the exact primary relaxed structure, occupancy seed, velocity seed, 20 ps NVT equilibration, 500 ps length, timestep, sampling interval, and estimator settings; change only production_ensemble from nvt to nve.

runs.purpose: Matched 500 ps NVE production control for formal-occ00-vel1701 at 800 K.
